title: 機械加工学
subtitle: Machining Engineering
teachers:
SETO Masahiro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
(1) Learn the basic theory of removal machining.
(2) Learn methods to measure cutting force and cutting edge temperature.
(3) Learn the types of tool damage and their causes.
(4) Learn how to manufacture cutting tools using powder metallurgy and surface
    coating techniques.
(5) Learn how to select cutting tool materials and cutting conditions.
advice:
This class will cover the following topics:
 1.  Classification of processing methods
 2.  Chip formation mechanism (Classification and formation mechanism of chips, Built-up edge, Generation
     conditions, and Methods to prevent built-up edge)
 3.  Cutting theory (Theoretical calculation of cutting force and Theoretical calculation of cutting
     temperature)
 4.  Measurement of cutting specifications (Cutting force, Cutting temperature, Chip thickness, and Contact
     length between chip and rake face)
 5.  Cutting tool wear and wear factors
 6.  Cutting tool material (Type and Classification)
 7.  Powder metallurgy technology and coating technology
 8.  Finished surface quality and control
 9.  Machinability of difficult-to-cut materials

Students should be aware of the teacher’s instructions in the class, because the schedules of quizzes, tests, and reports may change as the class progresses.
books:
Textbooks:[Practical Cutting Method (2nd Edition) ],Yoshio Fujimura, Kyouritsu syuppan
Reference books:[Introduction of Machining],Takekazu Sawa, Nikkann Kougyou Shinbun (in Japanese)
Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge:
Students are expected to watch the machining videos that supplement the lecture content.
In addition, it is important to have the experiences of touring machining facilities and attending a machine industry fair.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the basics of cutting theory.
Be able to understand the measurement methods for cutting specifications.
Be able to understand the form and factors of tool damage.
Be able to understand the types of cutting tool materials and their effective use.
Be able to understand the types of difficult-to-cut materials and their machinability.
Be able to select optimum cutting conditions and machine tools.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) A two-dimensional cutting model and the theoretical mechanism of shearing can be explained using figures.
(2) Measurement methods of cutting force and cutting temperature can be explained using detailed figures.
(3) The damage classification of cutting tools and its cause can be explained in detail.
(4) The method for manufacturing cutting tools with powder metallurgy and surface coating techniques can be explained in detail.
(5) The finished surface quality can be explained.
(6) The machining conditions, and tool shape for high-efficiency machining can be selected appropriately.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) A two-dimensional cutting model and the theoretical
    mechanism of shear can be explained.
(2) Measuring methods for cutting force and cutting
    temperature can be explained.
(3) The types and causes of cutting tool damage can be
    explained.
(4) Methods for using powder metallurgy and surface
    coating technology can be described.
(5) Surface roughness can be explained.
(6) The machining method, machining conditions, and tool
    shape can be selected.
